title: 第918章 昼夜不分第917章 环环相扣
lines: 赵真襄知道，吴谦口中所说的顾全大局。
就是赵真如为了疗伤，选择与吴谦携手修炼。
而她那时急于提升和恢复，正是要赶去救自己。
这么绕个圈下来一比，赵真襄不像她学习，确实高下立判。
可有些事，学一次就要豁出去一辈子。
赵真襄明白，学习代表着修炼，也明白修炼代表着蜕变。
到底是该看破世俗，为大局彻底蜕变。
还是守住最后那一丝底线，做一个欺世盗名的世俗之人……
随着思想在滑坡，赵真襄手上的力道，也不知不觉松了下来。
吴谦失去束缚，身体恢复自由。
从赵真襄的天人交战的表情，觉得时候差不多了。
便试探着凑到赵真襄耳边，先深吸一口气，品味着怡人的香气。
然后迷醉其中，以一个男女授受不亲的暧昧距离，悄声耳语道，
“所以，回到刚开始的问题。”
“真襄知道，为何咱家明知你不如真如，还执意要让你飞上天吗？”
赵真襄此时，再也没了刚开始的锐气，这么近的距离也没有炸毛。
只是静静听他说完，然后双眼迷茫的问道，
“为什么？”
“当然是为了你的修为精进，让你的境界更上一栋楼！”
“修为……境界……更上一层楼？”
听了吴谦的话，赵真襄喃喃重复着，就像是在说梦话一般。
似乎是没听懂话中含义，许久之后，赵真襄眼中才闪过一抹色彩。
逐渐恢复光彩……
“没错！就是更上一层楼！”吴谦并没有见好就收，而是继续鼓动簧舌道，
“只有更高深的境界，才能支持你做更多有意义的事情！”
“否则纵使你有一颗慈悲为怀的仙子之心，连师兄师姐都救不了，还谈什么普渡众生！”
“难道你就能眼睁睁看着，刘玉这种背信弃义的人，主持天下大局，将玄阳宫钉在历史的耻辱柱上吗！”
说到这，吴谦话锋一转，厉声问道，
“你身为玄阳宫妙子，在玄阳宫修炼，为了什么？”
受到吴谦引导，赵真襄想都没想，便脱口而出道，
“当然是为了天下苍生扞卫正道。”
话刚说出口，赵真襄便恍然大悟道，“所以我必须要提升境界！”
吴谦露出一个慈父般的姨妈笑，接缓缓点头，笑而不语。
谁能架得住如此蛊惑。
换句话说，越是仙子越是抵受不了这么大义凛然的鼓动。
赵真襄立即意动，恨不得现在就把境界提上去。
然后彻底毁坏，将同门救出去。
但这还不是结束，只是开始。
赵真襄之后便要率领玄阳宫，传道普济天下，为所有世人伸张正义……
这才是一个玄阳宫修士，应该做的事情！
想到这里，赵真襄的气势陡然一变，在缈缈仙气中，再添一分积极的灵动之气！
这下吴谦就更开心了，忍不住再靠近些，深深吸了一口气。
赵真襄正盘算着道图大愿，见吴谦还有心情如此，立即眉头一皱道，
“那该怎么做，才能提升境界……”
话只说一半，赵真襄便惊醒过来。
content_en:
Zhao Zhenxiang knew what Wu Qian said about taking into account the overall situation.
It was Zhao Zhenru who chose to practice hand in hand with Wu Qian in order to heal his wounds.
And she was eager to improve and recover at that time, just to save herself.
After going around and comparing like this, Zhao Zhenxiang did not learn from her and really judged her superiors.
But there are some things that, once you learn, you have to fight for the rest of your life.
Zhao Zhenxiang understands that learning represents cultivation, and he also understands that cultivation represents transformation.
After all, it is time to see through the world and completely transform for the overall situation.
Or should we stick to the last bottom line and be a worldly person who deceives the world and steals his reputation...
As his thoughts began to decline, the strength in Zhao Zhenxiang's hand also unknowingly relaxed.
Wu Qian lost his restraints and his body regained freedom.
Judging from the expression on Zhao Zhenxiang's face where heaven and man are at war, I feel that it's almost time.
Then he tentatively leaned towards Zhao Zhenxiang's ear, took a deep breath, and tasted the pleasant aroma.
Then he was fascinated by it, and with the ambiguous distance between a man and a woman without being intimate, he whispered quietly,
"So, back to the original question."
"Zhenxiang knows why our family insists on letting you fly into the sky even though we know you are not as good as Zhenru?"
At this time, Zhao Zhenxiang no longer had the vigor he had at the beginning, and he didn't have any hair at such a close distance.
Just listen to what he said quietly, and then ask with confused eyes,
"Why?"
"Of course it's for your cultivation and improvement, so that your realm can reach a higher level!"
"Cultivation...realm...reached a higher level?"
After listening to Wu Qian's words, Zhao Zhenxiang murmured and repeated, as if talking in his sleep.
It seemed that he did not understand the meaning of the words. After a long time, a flash of color flashed in Zhao Zhenxiang's eyes.
Gradually regaining its luster...
"That's right! It's just to get to the next level!" Wu Qian didn't give up when he was good, but continued to talk,
"Only a higher realm can support you to do more meaningful things!"
"Otherwise, even if you have a compassionate fairy heart, you can't even save your senior brothers and sisters, so how can you talk about saving all sentient beings!"
"Can you just watch a treacherous person like Liu Yu take charge of the overall situation of the world and nail Xuanyang Palace to the pillar of shame in history?"
Speaking of this, Wu Qian changed the topic and asked sharply,
"As a Taeko of Xuanyang Palace, why are you practicing in Xuanyang Palace?"
Under Wu Qian's guidance, Zhao Zhenxiang blurted out without even thinking,
"Of course it is to defend the right path for all people in the world."
As soon as the words were spoken, Zhao Zhenxiang suddenly realized, "So I must improve my level!"
Wu Qian smiled like a father and nodded slowly, smiling without saying a word.
Who can withstand such temptation.
In other words, the more fairies are, the less able they are to withstand such righteous instigation.
Zhao Zhenxiang immediately moved and wished he could reach a higher level now.
Then completely destroy it and rescue the fellow disciples.
But this is not the end, just the beginning.
From now on, Zhao Zhenxiang will lead Xuanyang Palace to preach to the world and uphold justice for all people...
This is what a Xuanyang Palace monk should do!
Thinking of this, Zhao Zhenxiang's aura suddenly changed, and he added a positive and agile aura to the misty fairy aura!
Wu Qian was even happier now. He couldn't help but get closer and took a deep breath.
Zhao Zhenxiang was thinking about Dao Tu's great wish. Seeing that Wu Qian was still in such a mood, he immediately frowned and said,
"Then what should we do to improve our realm..."
Zhao Zhenxiang woke up with a start as soon as he said half of the words.
title_en: Chapter 918 Day and night, Chapter 917 Linked together
